questions.q: What is Microsoft Entra ID, and what was it formerly called?
options: A networking service with no relationship to identity
A storage service formerly called Blob Storage
A billing tool formerly called Azure Cost Management
Azure's identity service, formerly called Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)
questions.explain: Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) refer to the same identity service — the name changed but the older name still appears in documentation and error messages.

questions.q: What is a "user" in Microsoft Entra ID?
options: A billing plan tier
An identity — a person or application — that can sign in and be granted permissions
A synonym for a resource group
A type of virtual machine size
questions.explain: A user is the basic identity that Entra ID tracks — every sign-in and every granted permission traces back to one.

questions.q: Why is granting a permission to a group, rather than to individual users one at a time, a meaningfully better practice?
options: It lets you manage permissions at scale — add or remove members from the group as the team changes, without re-granting the permission each time
Groups are required by Azure and individual users cannot be granted permissions at all
It has no real benefit beyond saving a small amount of typing
Groups automatically expire after 24 hours, making them safer
questions.explain: Granting a permission once to a group and managing membership separately is what makes permission management practical at scale, not just faster to type.

questions.q: Why does almost every action in Azure get checked against Entra ID?
options: Entra ID only applies to storage accounts, not other resources
Entra ID is optional and most actions bypass it entirely
Checking against Entra ID is purely a cosmetic step with no security purpose
Because you can't have permissions without first having a reliable way to know who is asking
questions.explain: Identity is the foundation access control is built on — confirming who's asking is required before deciding what they're allowed to do.

questions.q: How does an Entra ID tenant relate to an Azure subscription?
options: Entra ID has no relationship to subscriptions whatsoever
The same Entra ID tenant can be linked to multiple subscriptions, and its users/groups can be granted access across any of them
A tenant can only ever be linked to exactly one subscription for its entire lifetime
Subscriptions and tenants are the exact same thing with two different names
questions.explain: The subscription is the billing/resource boundary, while the Entra ID tenant is the separate, overarching identity answer that can span multiple subscriptions.
